# Bhavayami Nrithalaya

> Trusted dance academy at Lenin Balavadi, Vazhuthacaud, Trivandrum (Thiruvananthapuram), Kerala, India. Offering Bharatanatyam, Semi-Classical, Folk, Thiruvathira, Nrithyayoga, and competition coaching for children and students.

## About

Bhavayami Nrithalaya is a dance school located at Lenin Balavadi, Vazhuthacaud, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695010, India. The academy offers classical and folk dance education for children aged 5 and above, with both weekend and after-school batches. The school serves families from Vazhuthacaud, Sasthamangalam, Kawdiar, Kowdiar, Pattom, Medical College, and surrounding areas in Trivandrum.

## Dance Programs

- [Bharatanatyam Classes for Kids](https://www.bhavayami-nrithalaya.in/#bharatanatyam): Classical dance training with traditional techniques, Arangetram preparation, theory and practical sessions.
- [Semi-Classical Dance](https://www.bhavayami-nrithalaya.in/#semi-classical): Fusion of classical and contemporary styles for school programs and stage performances.
- [Kerala Folk Dance](https://www.bhavayami-nrithalaya.in/#folk-dance): Traditional Kerala folk dances for Onam celebrations, cultural programs, and group performances.
- [Thiruvathira Classes](https://www.bhavayami-nrithalaya.in/#thiruvathira): Kerala's beloved circular group dance with traditional songs for festivals.
- [Nrithyayoga](https://www.bhavayami-nrithalaya.in/#nrithyayoga): Unique fusion of yoga and dance promoting fitness, flexibility, and wellness.
- [Competition Coaching](https://www.bhavayami-nrithalaya.in/#competition): Kalolsavam and inter-school competition preparation with custom choreography.

## Key Information

- **Location**: Lenin Balavadi, Vazhuthacaud, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695010
- **Coordinates**: 8.5241°N, 76.9366°E
- **Age Group**: Children aged 5+, teens, and adults
- **Schedule**: Weekend classes (Saturday & Sunday), after-school batches (Tuesday & Thursday)
- **Website**: https://www.bhavayami-nrithalaya.in/
- **Contact**: Available via contact form on the website
